why: Analysis 2 tracks the key more closely: it explicitly lists "stop dismissing imports" as a stop-doing item, makes the unit-cost gap versus imports a scorecard metric, and anticipates the Stage 3 pattern of blaming dumping, labor and regulators. Analysis 1 is better calibrated (it correctly limits "no debt" to Year -6 and tags its thresholds as assumptions, while Analysis 2 asserts current no-debt and a No. 2 color rank the dossier does not give), but its stop-doing list and decline register match the key less well.
